Implement the supplied pattern mechanism even when its expected performance benefit is uncertain or could be zero. Do not choose NO_CHANGE because you think the change may be ineffective or slower. Return APPLY with one concrete, minimal workflow change. Preserve triggers, permissions, jobs, matrix, runners, environment, dependencies, shell commands, required checks and all original steps. For caching, add a narrow trusted actions/cache@v4 step or configure caching on an existing setup action. Key it by runner OS and the best available checked-in dependency inputs (lockfiles when present; otherwise dependency manifests, Makefile/install declarations and workflow setup). Cache only dependency download state, use exact keys without broad restore fallbacks, and always run every original install and test command on cache hits. Do not skip work based on cache-hit outputs. For timeout patterns change only job timeout-minutes, using baseline evidence with headroom. Do not add networking/deploy/publish/secret usage or replace action versions. The baseline already passed the required checks. Keep the change narrow so those same commands still run and can pass; the measured CI runs determine whether the candidate succeeds and whether it helps. If the method has a limitation, record it in rationale but still implement the closest valid version of the selected method. Return ONLY JSON: {pattern_id, decision: APPLY, rationale, workflow_yaml}. workflow_yaml must contain the complete changed file.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: 'http://localhost:3000'
  DATABASE_URL: 'postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/nelsonlaidev'
  UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL: 'http://localhost:8079'
  UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN: 'local-uprest-token-7f3c9a2e6b1d4f80'
  IP_ADDRESS_SALT: 'ci-ip-address-salt-for-testing-purposes'
  BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: 'ci-better-auth-secret-for-testing-purposes'
  JWT_SECRET: 'ci-jwt-secret-for-testing-purposes'
  RESEND_FROM_EMAIL: 'Nelson Lai <noreply@example.com>'
  GITHUB_CLIENT_ID: 'ci-github-client-id'
  GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET: 'ci-github-client-secret'

jobs:
  tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pnpm test:unit

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run Oxlint
        run: pnpm lint

  spellcheck:
    name: Spell Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run cspell
        run: pnpm lint:spell

  types:
    name: TypeScript
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run type check
        run: pnpm typecheck

  format:
    name: Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run Oxfmt format check
        run: pnpm format:check

  knip:
    name: Knip
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run Knip
        run: pnpm knip

  i18n:
    name: i18n
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run i18n check
        run: pnpm check:i18n

  e2e:
    name: End-to-end Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Install Playwright with dependencies
        run: pnpm playwright install --with-deps chromium --only-shell

      - name: Build apps
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Run services
        run: docker compose up -d

      - name: Verify Postgres is ready
        run: |
          until docker exec $(docker ps -qf "name=nelsonlaidev-postgres") pg_isready; do
            echo "Waiting for database..."
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Migrate database
        run: pnpm db:migrate

      - name: Seed database
        run: pnpm db:seed

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: pnpm test:e2e

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30
